explicit_family.name: CYCLIC_BIPOLAR_3X3
explicit_family.positive_clauses: A_i=(x_i OR x_{i+1} OR x_{i+3}) with indices modulo n
explicit_family.negative_clauses: B_i=(NOT x_i OR NOT x_{i+4} OR NOT x_{i+9}) with indices modulo n

for_every_pivot: enumerate exactly three positive and three negative parent clauses
verify every opposite-polarity parent pair intersects in variable support only at the pivot; if false, record the exact violating pair and do not assert the clean 3x3 geometry
construct all 9 exact DP parent pairs
measure forced exact-DP clause and literal delta before full normalization
structural_precheck.clean_geometry_target: 9 non-tautological pair resolvents and no cross-polarity second-variable overlap for every pivot
structural_precheck.raw_pressure_target_if_clean: remove 6 pivot-parent clauses and add 9 distinct resolvents, giving raw DeltaC=+3 for one eliminated variable

frozen_existing_stack_intake.first_action: run existing R47M full R33/affine/RUP/SA-BVE normalization with no new exact-DP projection
frozen_existing_stack_intake.if_terminal: record terminal and stop that n
frozen_existing_stack_intake.if_nonterminal: require exact joint-fixpoint integrity: R33 stalled unchanged, affine not recognized, RUP stalled with independent replay PASS and no strengthening, SA-BVE absent
frozen_existing_stack_intake.attack_state: the normalized nonterminal residual, not necessarily the raw generator formula

frozen_unit_weight_attack.candidate: for every current pivot, one exact-DP projection followed by frozen R47M joint normalization
frozen_unit_weight_attack.state_pressure: a_star=min a_req over nonterminal candidates if no terminal candidate
frozen_unit_weight_attack.counterexample_full_replay: independently replay every produced candidate before sealing
